prompt: Cities are becoming increasingly crowded. Some people say the solution is to move businesses and residents to the countryside. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write at least 250 words.
script:
In recent years, cities around the world have become more and more crowded, which causes problems such as traffic jam, pollution and expensive housing. Some people suggest that businesses and residents should move to the countryside. I partly agree with this idea.

On the one hand, moving some companies to rural areas could reduce pressure on big cities. If offices and factories are built in smaller towns, people would not need to travel to the city centre every day, so there will be less traffic and air pollution. Also, housing in the countryside is much cheaper, therefore families could buy bigger homes and have a better quality of life. For example, in my country the government moved the capital to a new city and this helped to develop a region which was not develop before.

On the other hand, this solution is not suitable for everyone. The countryside often lacks good hospitals, universities and entertainment, so many young people would not want to live there. Moreover, some businesses, for instance banks or technology companies, need to be close to their customers and to other companies, and moving them far away could make them less successful. It would also be very expensive to build new roads and internet connection in rural areas.

In conclusion, I believe that moving some businesses and people to the countryside can be a part of the solution, but it cannot solve the problem alone. Governments should also improve public transport and build more affordable housing in cities.
